method: Every source_url was fetched with User-Agent yamadori-dataset-worker/1 (the worker's own) and HEAD-checked with curl -sI: all 200, text/html or text/plain. approx_size_chars and extract_chunks come from passing the fetched body through a verbatim copy of mcp/worker.py html_to_text + chunks_of (12,000-char chunks, 60-chunk limit). Licences were read from the repo licence file, README or site footer named in licence_evidence. Domains were validated against domains.DOMAINS at write time. Nothing was submitted.
gaps_targeted: bench/recipes had no sources for Rust/WASM across C ABIs: systems.jsonl covers perf/DOD and modern_practice.jsonl covers editions/C/Zig. TSL, TypeGPU and R3F v10 are covered, but only thinly for pages specific to 0.12 or v10.
operator_command: For each candidate: datasets.create(c['source_url'], name=c['name'], kind='recipes', source_name=c['source_name'], source_url=c['source_url'], licence=c['licence'], language=c['language'], domains=c['domains']), or POST the same fields to /dash/api/dataset. create() enqueues dataset.fetch and parks the dataset at 'clarify'. Once the fetch is done, datasets.advance(id) enqueues extract, and mcp/worker.py runs the jobs. Rows go to bench/recipes/<name>.jsonl (datasets.recipe_file), and none of the names here collide with the existing 8 files.
